rules.cis_ref: NSA Network Infrastructure Security Guide v1.2 (U/OO/118623-22) §4.6 Limit authentication attempts (attempt limit + login delay)
rules.evidence: No 'login block-for': repeated failed logins never trigger a quiet period (VTY brute force). Info: no 'login delay'; no 'ip ssh logging events'.
references: NSA Network Infrastructure Security Guide v1.2 (U/OO/118623-22) §4.6 Limit authentication attempts (attempt limit + login delay)
Cisco IOS XE Login Enhancements (login block-for; also DISA STIG V-215668)
rules.remediation: Add: login block-for 120 attempts 3 within 60; login on-failure log; login on-success log
rules.title: Login brute-force protection

rules.cis_ref: NSA Network Infrastructure Security Guide v1.2 (U/OO/118623-22) §7.11 Configure remote network administration services
rules.evidence: SSH crypto not fully restricted: no 'ip ssh server algorithm encryption' (IOS XE 16.x defaults include CBC and 3DES); no 'ip ssh server algorithm mac' (defaults before IOS XE 17.10 include hmac-sha1); no 'ip ssh server algorithm kex' (defaults before IOS XE 17.10 include diffie-hellman-group14-sha1); no 'ip ssh dh min size' (IOS default 2048).
references: NSA Network Infrastructure Security Guide v1.2 (U/OO/118623-22) §7.11 Configure remote network administration services
Cisco IOS Security Command Reference D-L: ip ssh server algorithm, ip ssh dh min size
Cisco IOS XE 17.x: SSH Algorithms for Common Criteria Certification
rules.remediation: Use: ip ssh server algorithm encryption aes256-ctr aes192-ctr aes128-ctr; ip ssh server algorithm mac hmac-sha2-512 hmac-sha2-256 (IOS XE 16.5.1b+); ip ssh server algorithm kex ecdh-sha2-nistp521 ecdh-sha2-nistp384 ecdh-sha2-nistp256 (IOS XE 16.3+); ip ssh dh min size 4096
rules.title: SSH cryptography
